emergency.name: Emergency Room (ER) / Call Emergency
emergency.when_to_go: Life- or limb-threatening emergencies, severe chest pain, sudden numbness/paralysis, difficulty breathing, deep uncontrolled bleeding, severe burns.

urgent_care.name: Urgent Care Center
urgent_care.when_to_go: Non-life-threatening conditions needing same-day attention when your regular doctor is unavailable: sprains, minor fractures, cuts needing stitches, ear infections, mild asthma, urinary symptoms.

primary_care.name: Primary Care / Family Doctor / Telehealth
primary_care.when_to_go: Preventive screenings, long-term chronic condition management (hypertension, diabetes), medication refills, routine cold/flu, non-urgent aches.

specialist.name: Medical Specialist
specialist.when_to_go: Persistent, complex, or organ-specific symptoms requiring advanced diagnostic workups.

Orthopedics.description: Bones, joints, ligaments, tendons, and musculoskeletal system.

Gastroenterology.description: Digestive tract, stomach, intestines, liver, and gallbladder.

Neurology.description: Brain, spinal cord, and peripheral nervous system.

Endocrinology.description: Hormones, metabolism, thyroid, and adrenal glands.

Urology.description: Urinary tract in men and women, and male reproductive system.

Allergy & Immunology.description: Allergies, asthma, and immune system disorders.

triage_scenarios.trigger: chest pain or left arm heaviness
triage_scenarios.rationale: Chest pain can be an indicator of acute coronary syndrome. Must be evaluated immediately in an Emergency Department.

triage_scenarios.trigger: twisted ankle while running, can put weight with pain
triage_scenarios.rationale: Urgent Care clinics have on-site X-ray machines to rule out fractures and can provide splints or braces immediately.

triage_scenarios.trigger: mild throat tickle and runny nose for 2 days
triage_scenarios.rationale: Typical viral upper respiratory symptoms. Suitable for primary care or telehealth consultation if symptoms persist past 7–10 days.

triage_scenarios.trigger: new dark mole on shoulder with irregular borders
triage_scenarios.rationale: Moles with asymmetrical shapes or irregular borders should be inspected using dermoscopy by a dermatologist.

triage_scenarios.trigger: persistent morning stiffness in finger joints for 3 months
triage_scenarios.rationale: Chronic joint symptoms warrant a targeted evaluation for inflammatory or mechanical joint conditions.
